parsed.rationale: Both participating records in this cluster have is_test=true and reside in Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/FlowsheetConverterTests.swift. The two methods — parsesTimestampWithFractionalSeconds (line 198) and parsesTimestampWithoutFractionalSeconds (line 223) — are deliberately distinct test cases exercising different timestamp parsing code paths (with and without fractional seconds), which explains the high but sub-unity Jaccard similarity of 0.8. Merging or extracting these test methods would obscure the specific behavioral contract each test is asserting and couple unrelated test scenarios. Per the decision rules, any cluster where a participating record carries is_test=true mandates no-action.
